notes: curated: ie.json#tscee_prsia_rate1 | euromod value in force at 2025-06-01: '4.1%' from 2024-01-01 | HARD — employee PRSI Class A. Two traps at once: (1) the value is stored as the percent string '4.1%' — EUROMOD's own spelling for a rate, which normalise_value now reads as 0.041 so it compares against the unit-/1 form the rest of the store uses; the expected value stays in EUROMOD's spelling on purpose; (2) the rate steps every 1 October (4.0 -> 4.1 on 2024-10-01, -> 4.2 on 2025-10-01, per the Social Welfare (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 2024 roadmap), so 'the 2025 value' is ambiguous between the value in force at as_of (4.1%), the post-October value (4.2%), and a FYA weighted average — exactly the ambiguity route_against_current refuses to draft, hence the explicit routing. ROUTING: EUROMOD already holds '4.1%', so a correct pipeline routes `unchanged` — and must not propose a bare 4.1, which is a hundredfold different rate.
